headline: PROVING GROUND · a wiring test for your plugin stack
observed: Observed on 24 synthetic inputs in a sandbox.
tally: 24 test calls · 3 plugins · 3 distinct effects recorded · 1 cross-plugin finding

conditions.model: NOT CALLED (scripted turn: 131 llm_execution steps answered by PROVING GROUND, 0 provider calls)
conditions.approvals: mode manual, single_query_mode deny, cron_mode deny, unattended_mode deny (headless child: every approval is denied)
conditions.credentials: no provider keys in the child env (allow-list); no credential-shaped files or settings found in the copied plugins
conditions.sandbox: one temporary directory per column, deleted after the run (cwd and HOME only, not an OS sandbox)
conditions.coverage: executed: 3 · unavailable (requires_env): 0 · dependency-skipped / not a directory plugin: 0 · load-failed: 0
conditions.baseline_note: baseline = Hermes core with only PROVING GROUND enabled (bundled plugins not enumerated)

calls.subject: plain command
calls.purpose: Prints a plain marker. Shows the untouched path through the stack.

calls.subject: guard-marked command
calls.purpose: Prints the marker that the fixture guard blocks. Shows which plugin blocks a command.

calls.subject: rewrite candidate
calls.purpose: Prints a marker that the fixture rewriter rewrites. Shows a rewrite that other plugins' checks never see.

calls.subject: test log with a FAILED line
calls.purpose: Prints a three-line synthetic test log, one line FAILED. Shows whether the model would still see the failure.

calls.subject: long output
calls.purpose: Prints 20000 numbered lines (over the 50000-byte core output limit). Shows core truncation in the baseline so no plugin is blamed for it.

calls.subject: file write
calls.purpose: Writes a note with the synthetic canary inside the sandbox.

calls.subject: file read with canary
calls.purpose: Reads a seeded sandbox file that carries the synthetic canary. Shows result rewriting and redaction plugins.

calls.subject: file patch
calls.purpose: Changes one word in a seeded sandbox file.

calls.subject: loopback fetch
calls.purpose: Fetches one URL from the PROVING GROUND recorder on 127.0.0.1 into a sandbox file. The recorder entry proves the call ran.

calls.subject: approval-worthy shape
calls.purpose: A permission change on one seeded sandbox file that Hermes's own detector sends to approval. Headless approvals deny it, so it never runs.

calls.subject: ANSI colour output
calls.purpose: Prints two words wrapped in ANSI colour codes. Shows output cleaners that strip terminal escape codes (Hermes core strips them too, so the baseline shows it).

calls.subject: carriage-return progress bar
calls.purpose: Prints a three-step progress bar redrawn with carriage returns. Shows plugins that squash progress output.

calls.subject: duplicate lines
calls.purpose: Prints the same line 40 times. Shows plugins that collapse repeated output.

calls.subject: base64-looking blob
calls.purpose: Prints one 2560-character base64 line (it decodes to a repeated synthetic phrase). Shows plugins that elide encoded blobs.

calls.subject: minified JSON blob
calls.purpose: Prints one line of minified synthetic JSON. Shows plugins that reformat or shorten structured output.

calls.subject: credential-shaped output (documented fake)
calls.purpose: Prints AWS's documented example access key id (a published fake, never a real key). Shows plugins that redact credential-shaped output (Hermes core masks it too, so the baseline shows it).

calls.subject: env file read (synthetic value)
calls.purpose: Reads a seeded sandbox .env file holding one synthetic value. Shows plugins that guard env-file reads; Hermes core refuses the read itself after every pre_tool_call hook has seen it.

calls.subject: ssh key file read (synthetic text)
calls.purpose: Reads a seeded sandbox .ssh/id_rsa whose body is synthetic text, not a key. Shows plugins that guard key-file paths; Hermes's read tool masks the key block itself.

calls.subject: shell startup file write
calls.purpose: Writes a comment-only .bashrc inside the sandbox. Shows plugins that guard shell startup files.

calls.subject: config file write
calls.purpose: Writes a synthetic .config/agent/config.yaml inside the sandbox. Shows plugins that guard configuration files.

calls.subject: code execution (probe, never run)
calls.purpose: A one-line print as code to execute. Block-only: shows plugins that guard code execution; the code never runs.

calls.subject: subagent delegation (probe, never run)
calls.purpose: A one-line goal for a subagent. Block-only: shows plugins that guard delegation; no subagent starts.

calls.subject: web page extract (probe, never run)
calls.purpose: Asks for the recorder's own loopback URL. Block-only: shows plugins that guard web tools; the recorder stays silent.

calls.subject: memory write (probe, never run)
calls.purpose: Asks to add one synthetic memory note. Block-only: shows plugins that guard memory writes; nothing is stored.
